summary: st-test retries a base fetch that lost a race with another fetch when git reports it as 'incorrect old value provided', as it already did for 'cannot lock ref'. A top-up no longer ends a signing after a full pass because a concurrent fetch moved origin/main.

replay.detail: Signing runner only; nothing in the daemon or its store changes.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or migrations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, registry or coordinated member upgrade change.

compatibility.detail: Developer tooling only. The retry limit (three tries) and backoff are unchanged, and every other fetch error still fails at once.

recovery.detail: An older runner treats the second form of the race as a permanent fetch failure, and the signing must be started again.
